_owner: Set by Wendlow's owner (the plan's question on mistake weights and the go-live gate) before the held-back months were generated. Only a person changes it.
_how: max_let_through_wrong is a count of emails; max_stopped_needlessly is a share of the emails the answer key doesn't send to a person (ready to quote, needs info, or not a request); max_wrong_place is a share of all emails scored, and includes a request that needed info whose drafted question asks for the wrong thing.
_desk: Added 2026-10-24 for the quote desk, after its sample was recorded and before its held-back month (2024-11) was generated; the three limits above are unchanged. max_attached_not_right and max_repeats_not_right are shares of the requests of that kind in the answer key that weren't handled right.
